Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the use of state lottery proceeds for higher education financial aid.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of state lottery proceeds for financialaid for higher education purposes; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature intends to redirect statelottery proceeds to provide additional funding to student financial aidprograms.
